items.title: AutoCAD Productivity Suite
items.description: A collection of custom AutoLISP routines created to automate repetitive drafting tasks and improve efficiency in civil engineering drawing workflows.
items.details: Developed several focused AutoLISP utilities to simplify repetitive drafting operations in AutoCAD. These scripts help automate tasks such as layer adjustments, coordinate extraction, drawing cleanup, and repetitive drafting commands commonly used in civil engineering drawings and site layout preparation. The goal of these tools is to reduce manual operations, improve drafting consistency, and speed up production workflows.
items.use_cases: Civil drafting workflows, site layout drawings, repetitive command automation, drawing cleanup
items.features: Custom AutoLISP commands, drafting workflow automation, repetitive task reduction
items.impact: Reduces repetitive drafting effort and improves drawing preparation speed during civil engineering drafting tasks

items.title: Revit BIM Automation
items.description: A set of custom pyRevit scripts developed to automate repetitive BIM modelling and data tasks inside Autodesk Revit.
items.details: Developed several focused automation scripts using Python and pyRevit to simplify repetitive tasks within Revit models. These tools include utilities such as a Filter Override Tool for automatically applying graphical overrides and an Elevation Calculator to extract and verify elevation data from model elements. The scripts are designed to improve modelling efficiency, reduce manual work, and support better model coordination.
items.use_cases: BIM modelling automation, model visualization control, elevation data verification, workflow optimization
items.features: Filter Override Tool, Elevation Calculator, parameter-based automation, model workflow utilities
items.impact: Reduces repetitive manual operations in BIM modelling and improves consistency when working with Revit models

items.title: Digital PDF Flip-Book Engine
items.description: An interactive web-based engine that converts traditional PDF documents into immersive digital flip-books with realistic page-turn animations.
items.details: Developed a browser-based flip-book viewer that transforms static PDF documents into an interactive reading experience. The system uses JavaScript libraries and custom front-end design to simulate page turning with smooth animations, giving the feel of a physical magazine or book. It is designed for publishing technical articles, portfolios, and documentation in a more engaging format on the web.
items.use_cases: Digital magazines, technical documentation, portfolio presentation, interactive articles
items.features: Realistic page-turn animation, responsive design, browser-based viewer, interactive navigation
items.impact: Improves the readability and presentation of digital publications by converting static PDFs into interactive web-based flip books

items.title: Personal Finance Tracker
items.description: A lightweight web application designed to help users track income and expenses while visualizing monthly financial trends.
items.details: Developed a simple money tracking web application that allows users to log income and expense entries through a web interface. The system organizes financial data into categories and visualizes spending trends using charts. Data persistence is handled through browser storage or backend integration such as Google Sheets, making the tool lightweight and accessible from any device with a browser.
tech: HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Chart.js, Google Apps Script, Google Sheets
items.use_cases: Personal expense tracking, budgeting for students, financial habit monitoring
items.features: Income and expense logging, category-based tracking, financial trend charts, lightweight browser-based interface
items.impact: Helps users understand spending patterns, organize personal finances, and maintain simple financial records

items.title: AEC Calculation Engine
items.description: A suite of high-precision engineering calculators integrated directly into the web, bridging structural analysis formulas with interactive UI.
items.details: Includes the Beam Analyzer, Gradient Solver, and Scale Converter. These tools allow site engineers to perform complex checks on-site without needing heavy desktop software, ensuring data-driven decisions on the ground.
